@common.sizeUnit.byte.sameAsSourceJustification: pt-BR uses the English word: the macOS pt-BR Finder writes “byte” / “bytes” (LocalizableMerged.json SP27, SP28), and GNOME Nautilus pt-BR “%s byte” / “%s bytes”. Only the many branch is added for pt plurals.

@common.sizeUnit.kibibyte.sameAsSourceJustification: IEC binary symbol: pt-BR keeps the Latin IEC symbols, as Microsoft pt-BR terminology (MiB, GiB) and KDE Dolphin pt-BR (“ MiB”) do; distinct from the decimal symbol.

@common.sizeUnit.mebibyte.sameAsSourceJustification: IEC binary symbol: pt-BR keeps the Latin IEC symbols, as Microsoft pt-BR terminology (MiB, GiB) and KDE Dolphin pt-BR (“ MiB”) do; distinct from the decimal symbol.

@common.sizeUnit.kilobyte.sameAsSourceJustification: SI decimal symbol with the lowercase SI prefix k, as Brazil’s SI usage writes it; Total Commander pt-BR (“kB/s”) and GNOME Nautilus pt-BR keep kB; distinct from KiB.

@common.sizeUnit.megabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: Unit symbol: the macOS pt-BR Finder writes the same symbol (LocalizableMerged.json SP25 “MB”), so pt-BR keeps it.
